text_block_list.text:
On my way home. I noticed the lights were 
on in the dance studio and peeked inside, 
wondering if someone had forgotten to turn 
them off—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: P-Peace, peace...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Kh... W-Why am I the one doing this pose?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, why did the fan 
request this pose?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's not in the concert choreography, and 
besides, that's supposed to be Gold Ship's 
pose...

"Is she doing special training for the 
concert performance? Curfew is 
approaching, so I should warn her, but she 
seems intensely focused..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No. Whatever it is, I have to respond to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A Winning Live is a place to express 
gratitude to the fans who support us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Cast aside all shame and bring joy to 
everyone with all my might. That is what I 
decided...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Alright, with that decided, on to the 
next! The next one is quite a challenge as 
well, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: M-Moe-moe~ kiss...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's giving me the jitters! This 
really isn't my style at all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Thank goodness nobody was around. 
If anyone saw me like this, I'd be a 
laughingstock—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
…………T-Trainer? How long have you been 
standing there……?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
…………T-Trainer? How long have you been 
standing there……?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Really...? For real, truly, honestly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Swear on the cafeteria-exclusive 
tiramisu...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Then I shall believe you. If you 
swear upon that tiramisu, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I still have fan ser— dance 
training to do, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall withdraw before curfew, so please 
do head back without worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: !? That would be a prob...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all. Please don't worry about 
me and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, farewell...!

Firmly pushed out by Mejiro McQueen, I was 
forcefully evicted from the room...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My! Is that really true?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... I'm not used to it 
myself, so it made me feel a bit 
ticklish."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Which means...? You saw... that just 
now...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Hyaaaa~~h! Wh-Wh-What on earth!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really fine!? That "moe moe" just 
now... k-k-k...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway! Don't you dare tell anyone, 
understood?! Down to your final 
descendants...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"You absolutely, positively promise, 
okay...! And one more thing!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Around where?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So... umm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-Which part of it... was "really great," 
exactly?

I gave Mejiro McQueen my thoughts, and 
accompanied her in special training right 
up until curfew.
